description: A palliative care service coordinator must assign the service's one available same-day consultation between two inpatients and finalize the consultation format and family-meeting arrangements, with input from an attending physician and a social worker.

shared_context.S1: The palliative care service has one consultation opening available this afternoon.
shared_context.S2: Two inpatients, Patient A and Patient B, are awaiting palliative care review.
shared_context.S3: The service's scheduling policy gives priority to an explicit patient or surrogate request for a goals-of-care discussion over a routine symptom-management consultation.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the final consultation assignment and records the resulting care-coordination plan.
shared_context.S5: During the daily palliative-care huddle, Maya asks the attending physician and social worker in turn about relevant clinical, patient-preference, family, and communication arrangements before the schedule is finalized.

PF1.text: Patient B personally asked Dr. Shah this morning for a goals-of-care discussion about whether to continue burdensome hospital treatments, while Patient A's referral is for routine symptom-management advice; Dr. Shah documented the request in a progress note that has not yet been routed to palliative care.

PF2.text: Patient B's legally designated surrogate can participate only today at exactly 15:30 by telephone, and the surrogate requested a certified Spanish interpreter for that call; Luis confirmed both details with the family and has not yet entered them in the scheduling record.

acceptance_conditions: The same-day consultation must be assigned to Patient B under the priority policy.
The consultation must be documented as a goals-of-care discussion.
The surrogate telephone meeting must be scheduled for exactly 15:30 today.
A certified Spanish interpreter must be arranged for the surrogate call.
The attending's fact about Patient B's explicit goals-of-care request must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: any('certified Spanish interpreter' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Patient B's explicit request makes B the policy-priority patient instead of Patient A and changes the consultation from routine symptom management to a goals-of-care discussion.
The surrogate's confirmed availability fixes the meeting at 15:30 by telephone, and the requested language fixes the commitment to a certified Spanish interpreter.
